_comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/guard-paths.json. tests: test code, developer must not touch. qaConfig: test-runner config, same rule. shared: either may change, reminder only. Without this file only git refs are checked. Each entry is a repo-relative path matched by qg_common.pathMatches (agent-guard and the quality gates alike): a plain entry is that path or a directory prefix ("tests/", "pkg/testdata"); a glob keeps * and ? within one path segment and **/ matches any depth including the root ("**/*_test.go" covers a_test.go and pkg/a_test.go; "*_test.go" only the root); a glob ending in / covers every path under a directory it matches ("**/testdata/").
